text.tspan: 1. Each row in this table represents an Initial, and each column represents a Final. Only combinations with common Hanzi are considered. Interjections and dialectal words are excluded;
2. Yellow cells indicate that the Pinyin spelling for the pronunciation in that cell is irregular. It is not directly combined from the Initial and the Final;

3. Regardless of whether the corresponding Pinyin spelling is regular or not, the actual pronunciation in each cell can be viewed as a combination of the pronunciations of the corresponding Initial and Final.
